rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The AICC website says 'On the 3rd of September 2010 Smt. Sonia Gandhi was unanimously elected President of the Indian National Congress'.

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The same page says that at a function at the AICC Headquarters, 24 Akbar Road, attended by the Prime Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh, Shri Oscar Fernandes, Chairman of the Central Election Authority, declared that Smt. Sonia Gandhi had been unanimously elected President, read out the Certificate of Election and handed it over to her.
